title: Saturn’s Polygonal Cloud Mystery

scenes.text: Saturn’s south pole hides a ten‑sided cloud
Cassini captured a perfect decagonal cloud in 2023
scenes.label: DECAGON CLOUD

scenes.text: It forms from a standing atmospheric wave, similar to the hexagon but with a different wave number
scenes.label: ATMOSPHERIC WAVE

scenes.text: Scientists say the decagon challenges existing models that only predicted a single hexagonal jet
scenes.label: MODEL CHALLENGE

scenes.text: Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: Cassini revealed a rare ten‑sided cloud over Saturn’s south pole, a shape never seen before. This discovery forces scientists to rethink atmospheric wave models. Follow for daily science!
